Texas Rangers investigate Camp Mystic flood deaths for manslaughter

The Texas Rangers have launched a criminal investigation into the deaths of 27 girls at Camp Mystic during devastating flooding last year. Investigators are seeking evidence that could lead to charges of manslaughter or negligent homicide. Court documents indicate the investigation is ongoing.
